test_title: PYST 19: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Blessing in disguise

options.text: Bad thing that turns out to be good
A good thing introduced into your life as a blessing
A good deed rewards as a blessing

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Blessing in disguise"** means **"Bad thing that turns out to be good"**.
 
• **It refers** to an unexpected positive outcome from a challenging or difficult situation.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: *'Bad thing that turns out to be good'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A good thing introduced into your life as a blessing **(आशीर्वाद के रूप में आपके जीवन में पेश की गई अच्छी चीज़) does not match with the idiom.
 
• **A good deed rewards as a blessing** (एक अच्छा कार्य एक आशीर्वाद के रूप में इनाम देता है) is not the same as the idiom.
 
• **Something that happens very rarely** (ऐसी चीज़ जो बहुत कम होती है) does not convey the same meaning.

39:Ta8b,

The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Approbation'.**
